verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's workspace config (`.humanlayer/workspace.json`) creates per-task worktrees across one or more repositories and supports setup commands and local files to copy. The docs also show the agent itself helping to configure a multi-repo workspace and choose setup commands. However, the remote-host docs say the host must already have access to the code, tools and credentials the agent needs, so the environment is largely pre-provisioned rather than bootstrapped by the agent. Missing for 10: evidence the agent clones repositories from scratch, explicit dependency-installation automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
